name: Zenith Tri-Anchor
effects: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] depending on if entry damage was Water/Ice/Earth, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Ward (Water, Ice, Earth)] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] depending on if entry damage was Water/Ice/Earth, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Ward (Water, Ice, Earth)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Ward (Water, Ice, Earth)
description.text: Increases [Ice/Earth/Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Ice, Earth or Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Ward (Ice, Earth, Water) after using a Ice, Earth or Water ability (max 1), grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Anchor Rain+
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Guidance: Ward (Water/Ice/Earth)
description.text: One single ranged attack (3.36) capped at 99999, grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (25s)] to all allies if Laguna and Kiros are not in the party, grants [100% Critical (15s)] to all allies if one of Laguna or Kiros are in the party, grants [100% Critical (15s)] and [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] to all allies if Laguna and Kiros are in the party

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
